item.projecthero.book_of_azarath.tooltip: Its pages stay blank by day. Read it at night.
item.projecthero.raven_cloak.tooltip: A hooded cloak. On Raven its colour follows her Composure.
message.projecthero.raven.title: Raven
message.projecthero.raven.subtitle: Azarath Metrion Zinthos
message.projecthero.raven.acquired: The book's words settle into you. You are Raven.
message.projecthero.raven.acquired_hint: Stay calm: your Composure is the thin line under the Dark Energy bar. Double-tap Space to levitate. Hold Shift+V to meditate. Press I for your moves.
message.projecthero.raven.already: You already know the book's words
message.projecthero.raven.daylight: The pages are blank in daylight. Read it at night.
message.projecthero.raven.too_strong: That one is too strong to lift
message.projecthero.raven.no_debris: No loose ground nearby to tear up
message.projecthero.raven.heal_too_weak: You're too weak to take their pain
message.projecthero.raven.drained: The rage drains away. You are calm, and empty.
hud.projecthero.raven.title: Raven
projecthero.raven.ability.dark_bolt.desc: A fast bolt of black energy: 8 damage, and it passes through the first creature it hits into the next. +25% while your emotions leak. 8 Dark Energy.
projecthero.raven.ability.telekinesis.de: Hold to wrap the creature, item or block you look at in black energy and steer it with your look. Let go to throw it: a creature takes 10 damage plus the impact when it lands, a block flies like a falling block and hits for 10. Bosses are too strong to lift. With mob griefing off you lift an energy copy of a block; with it on the real block goes back after 10 seconds. 10 Dark Energy, then 4 a second.
projecthero.raven.ability.shadow_grasp.d: Black claws rise out of the ground under the creature you look at (up to 24 blocks) and hold it still for 2 seconds: 6 damage. 15 Dark Energy.
projecthero.raven.ability.soul_self.desc: Your soul flies out as a great raven of dark energy, 25 blocks along your look, engulfing every creature it passes: 16 damage, Blindness and Slowness. 35 Dark Energy, 8 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.ability.dark_shield.de: Hold for a dome of black energy (3-block radius) that moves with you, swallowing projectiles and absorbing up to 40 damage. If it breaks you can't raise it for 3 seconds. 5 Dark Energy a second.
Only in Rage (Composure under 10). For 15 seconds you become a giant cloaked shadow, three times your size, with four red eyes. Three times, tentacles of dark energy grab everything within 12 blocks, lift it and slam it down for 30 damage; players are struck with fear. Afterwards you're drained: calm again, with no Dark Energy. 3 minute cooldown.
projecthero.raven.ability.shadow_dash.de: Become a streak of shadow and shoot 10 blocks along your look, passing through creatures. Nothing can hurt you while you're a streak. 12 Dark Energy, 1 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.ability.shadow_step.de: Sink into your shadow and erupt out of the ground beside the creature you look at (up to 20 blocks): dark claws launch it into the air for 12 damage. 20 Dark Energy, 4 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.ability.telekinetic_wa: Lift every creature within 8 blocks 4 blocks into the air, hold them there for a second, then slam them down for 12 damage. 30 Dark Energy.
projecthero.raven.ability.debris_storm.d: Tear up 8 nearby blocks into an orbit around you. Press Shift+C again, or left click, to fire them one at a time at your aim: 8 damage each. With mob griefing off they are energy copies and the ground is untouched; with it on the real blocks go back after 10 seconds. 30 Dark Energy.
projecthero.raven.ability.empath_heal.de: Aim at a squadmate to take up to 10 of their missing health as your own damage and heal them double. Aimed at no one, heal yourself 4 and shake off harmful effects. 20 Dark Energy, 10 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.ability.meditate.desc: Hold to float cross-legged, chanting softly. Composure and Dark Energy come back fast, but you can't move or attack.
projecthero.raven.ability.flight.desc: Double-tap Space in the air to rise into calm levitation, and again to land. Free. When you aren't flying you always fall slowly.
projecthero.guide.raven.body: Raven, daughter of Trigon, an empath from Azarath. Her dark energy lifts and throws anything, she slips through shadow, sends out her raven-shaped soul-self, shields, and heals by taking others' pain. She must stay calm: her emotions leak out as power, and when she loses control Trigon's red-eyed side breaks through.
projecthero.guide.raven.getting.body: Find the Book of Azarath in ancient city chests or stronghold library chests. Read it (right-click) at night; by day its pages are blank. It replaces any Primary power you have. Random serums never give it.
projecthero.guide.raven.traits.body: 20 health and 10% less damage taken. You always fall slowly unless you are flying. Double-tap Space to levitate.
projecthero.guide.raven.energy.body: The violet Slab on your HUD, up to 100. It refills 5 a second and pays for your moves. Holding Telekinesis or the Dark Shield drains it instead.
projecthero.guide.raven.composure.body: The thin Hairline under the Slab. It starts calm. Taking damage, big moves and hostile mobs around you for a long time push it toward Rage; quiet spells bring it back slowly, and meditating brings it back fast. Under 30 your emotions leak: now and then a nearby pane of glass or a lamp cracks (it only really breaks with mob griefing on) or a creature is shoved away, and your bolts hit 25% harder. Under 10 is Rage: four red eyes, and Trigon's Wrath unlocks.
projecthero.guide.raven.look.body: Your skin stays your own. Dark wisps curl from your hands, your eyes glow white while you cast, and at Rage four red eyes open.
projecthero.guide.raven.cloak.body: Craft it from blue wool, black wool, an ender pearl and redstone (shaped like a chestplate). Anyone can wear it. On Raven the hood and cape are blue, turn white when she is very calm, and take a dark red tint at Rage.
projecthero.guide.raven.commands.body: Operators: /projecthero power tune raven energy <0-100>, composure <0-100>, cooldowns.
